title: Managed Database: included IOPS
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database included IOPS is specified by contracted tier. Included provisioned IOPS per node; integer. Additional provisioned IOPS; USD per IOPS-month.

| Contracted tier | Included iops | Iops rate |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | 3000 | 0.021 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | 4000 | 0.021 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | 6000 | 0.021 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | 8000 | 0.021 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | 12000 | 0.021 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | 16000 | 0.021 |

## Hypothetical tier comparison
Hypothetical comparison limited to included IOPS: choosing Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore instead of Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore changes this value from 3000 to 16000, a difference of 13000. This comparison describes that parameter alone.
